reason: As someone who has quit three of these, A answers my real worries: no contract with skip/cancel any time, meal swaps, a call with the dietitian first, the order deadline, and a frank account of why 14 self-selected results with untracked medication prove little. B is honest on the A1C numbers too but adds unsupported fluff ("people stay because the meals fit their lives," "less than most takeout," protein/fiber claims) and leaves out the low-risk details that would get me to pay $59.
